usedFor: Moneybird holds customers and invoices, and MailerLite holds your mailing list, so “New Contact” can run “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Moneybird, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: New customers from your books join your mailing list, and repeats are updated rather than duplicated.

watchOut: Moneybird contacts are bookkeeping records, so check who agreed to marketing before “Create or Update Subscriber” adds them.
